scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names schemas,dispatch,web,api "npm run dev -w @caseflow/schemas" "npm run dev -w @caseflow/dispatch" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @caseflow/api && npm run build -w @caseflow/web && npm run build -w @caseflow/outbox-dispatcher
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:release
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:shared && npm run test:integration -w @caseflow/api
scripts.test:processor: uv run --project services/document-processor --locked pytest services/document-processor/tests -m "not integration"
scripts.format:python: uv run --project services/document-processor --locked ruff format services infra
scripts.format:python:check: uv run --project services/document-processor --locked ruff format --check services infra
scripts.test:facts: uv run --project services/fact-extractor --locked pytest services/fact-extractor/tests -m "not integration"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @caseflow/schemas && npm run build -w @caseflow/dispatch
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build:shared && npm run build:lambda -w @caseflow/api && npm run build -w @caseflow/outbox-dispatcher
scripts.test:search: uv run --project services/search-indexer --locked pytest services/search-indexer/tests -m "not integration"
